about_the_game:
In the vast universe, there exists a legend... Those who can witness the shadows of the stars will awaken mysterious and powerful abilities. The organization you belong to has been relentlessly pursuing this power, containing gifted individuals and conducting secret experiments on them.

However, an accident shattered the established order, allowing some test subjects with dangerous abilities to escape the organization’s control. Was this truly an accident, or a carefully crafted conspiracy? As the one appointed by the organization, you will find the answers through your pursuit of these test subjects.

Ancient winged beings, followers of alien gods, a girl who has sealed away her true heart, a songstress gazing across the starry river...

Will you choose to delve into the minds of the test subjects, uncovering the stories behind those who have descended into madness, and overcome them with wisdom? Or will you bring a decisive end to this chase through merciless slaughter, burying everything in the silent abyss?

Persuasion and reconciliation, conflict and conclusion—the power of choice is in your hands!

Section Six Requiem is a card game with unique mechanics,

offering a distinctive experience that combines strategy and storytelling seamlessly!

  • Protect your core “Heart Card” while carefully building a deck that’s uniquely yours, adapting to the ever-changing battlefield!

  • Engage in intense battles with test subjects, using tactics to fight fiercely—or persuade calmly as you uncover the stories behind the subjects

Game Duration: 3 Hours

Controls: Use the mouse to play, allowing you to move, swap, draw, discard cards, and end turns.

  • Heart Defense: Your health is represented by cards on the field. Stay alert to enemy attacks and protect your "Heart."

  • Action Management: Control the positioning of your cards, adjust their placement to resolve effects, and watch out for your opponent's attacks, defenses, forges, and curses!

  • Deck Update: You can discard or draw cards at any time. In critical moments, seize a slim chance to turn the tide.

  • Dialogue System: Communicate with the test subjects by expressing two sets of emotions (positive-negative, confidence-doubt) to uncover the truth

  • Dialogue System: Communicate with test subjects using conversation cards and a pair of Affirmation and Denial cards. Uncover the truth through interaction.

10+ Test Subjects: Carefully crafted characters with distinct personalities and unique mechanics

50+ Game Cards: Cards with a unique art style and synergistic mechanics

15+ Advanced Mode Modifiers: Selectable advanced modifiers for a fresh experience

  • Art: 阿诺榕, 电车, DaNGo_iz, 广廿尺, 百合子, 米鲁  

  • Animation: DaNGo_iz, 楠哥, 三形

  • Music: 鱼头
